scope: deterministic recovery drills through production profile activation boundaries

scenarios.name: issuer-replacement
scenarios.state_after: generation 2 active under replacement issuer; revoked predecessor issuer rejected without persistence changes

scenarios.name: revoked-profile-new-generation
scenarios.state_before: revoked content generation 1 remains active while a revoked replacement attempt is rejected atomically
scenarios.state_after: a subsequently valid generation 2 replacement is active; generation 1 is retained as last-known-good

scenarios.name: local-wrap-key-loss
scenarios.state_before: generation 1 activated through the production local-wrap activation boundary
scenarios.state_after: generation 2 activation fails before transaction storage after device-key loss; active and transaction state remain unchanged

scenarios.name: interrupted-activation
scenarios.state_after: precommit interruption restores generation 1; postcommit interruption retains fully verified generation 2; transaction markers are cleared

limitations: These deterministic local drills do not claim production keystore durability, operating-system crash consistency, or deployed infrastructure recovery.
